Important tips for anyone flying with an animal
It is easier with this note
Traveling with your pet
Please read this before you arrive so we can keep the trip smooth for you and your animal. At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, we guide travelers through the basics, check the crate, and note any service updates for the cabin team. <<FACT F061>> Pack familiar bedding and water, and keep the crate calm and secure for the journey. <<FACT F067>> If you need help, please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk before boarding.
